import sqlite3, json, statistics as st
db = sqlite3.connect("file:ob_wall3.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
by = {}
for sym, kind, price, tick, path in db.execute("select symbol,kind,price,tick,path from levels where kind='wall'"):
    p = json.loads(path); order = price + tick
    k = next((i for i,(t,b) in enumerate(p) if b <= order), None)
    if k is None: continue
    seg = [b for t,b in p[k:]]
    by.setdefault(sym, []).append(((max(seg)/order-1)*100, (min(seg)/order-1)*100))
print("пара | заполнено | макс вверх: медиана / 90% / максимум | мин вниз: медиана / 10% / минимум  (в % от входа, за остаток пути)")
for sym, v in sorted(by.items()):
    mx = sorted(a for a,b in v); mn = sorted(b for a,b in v)
    q = lambda s,f: s[min(len(s)-1,int(len(s)*f))]
    print("%-9s %3d | %+.2f / %+.2f / %+.2f | %+.2f / %+.2f / %+.2f" % (sym, len(v), q(mx,.5), q(mx,.9), mx[-1], q(mn,.5), q(mn,.1), mn[0]))
allmx = [a for v in by.values() for a,b in v]
print("всего", len(allmx), "доходили до +0.8:", sum(a>=0.8 for a in allmx), "; до -0.8:", sum(b<=-0.8 for v in by.values() for a,b in v))
